description_en: Directories to symlink from the main repository into each worktree to avoid duplicating large directories on disk. No directories are symlinked by default. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings#worktree-settings
description_ja: ディスク上のディレクトリ重複を避けるため、メインリポジトリから各ワークツリーにシンボリックリンクを貼るディレクトリを指定します。
use_case_ja:
- `--worktree`セッションにおいて、node_modulesなどの巨大なディレクトリをコピーせず、元のリポジトリを参照させることでディスク容量を節約します。
- sparsePathsと組み合わせて使用し、ワークツリー作成時の効率を向上させます。
- デフォルトではシンボリックリンクは作成されません。
doc_snippets: List directories in sparsePaths , not individual files. Root-level files like package.json , tsconfig.base.json , and lock files are always checked out alongside the directories you list. Root-level directories are not, so include in the list if you want the repository root's .claude/settings.json , .claude/rules/ , or .claude/skills/ available inside the worktree. To avoid duplicating large directories like node_modules across worktrees, pair sparsePaths with symlinkDirectories in the same .claude/settings.json :

This creates a symlink from each worktree's node_modules/ back to the main repository's copy rather than duplicating it on disk. The sparsePaths and symlinkDirectories settings are read from your starting directory before the worktree is created. After creation, the session's working directory is the worktree root, not the subdirectory you launched from. Project settings inside the worktree therefore load from the worktree root's .claude/settings.json , the checked-out copy of the repository root's file. Put any other settings you need inside worktrees, such as permission rules or hooks, in the repository root's .claude/settings.json . For the full worktree settings reference, see Worktree settings .
